It can solve the problem of communications disconnected in fieldwork thoroughly.

articleTitle: The Sound Recognition of Artillery Projectile Shape Based on Least Squares Fuzzy Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: Least squares fuzzy support vector machine is proposed based on the theory of fuzzy support vector classification. Based on the theory of ballistic shock wave, the sound identification of artillery projectile is achieved by training and testing to the two samples data of 130mm and 152mm artillery projectile shock wave.

Author Keywords: least squares fuzzy support vector machine

articleTitle: An AVO Inversion Algorithm Base on Time-Lapse Seismic Data
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: To monitor fluid flow dynamically and obtain more reliable gas reservoir information of 3D time-lapse seismic data, in this paper we present a 4D-AVO inversion algorithm, in which visualization technology, cross-correlation technology, time and phase shift theory, matched filtering algorithm and normalization technology are used to correct and analyze time-varying seismic data after AVO inversion. Some experimental 3D time-lapse seismic data of CDP trace gathers are analyzed. The results show that it is an efficient way to estimate the volume changes made by the exploiting of oil and gas reservoir while clearly show the changes in oil reservoir area.

articleTitle: Research on the Information Publication Technology in Integrated E-Government System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: At first, the standard information structure based on XML (extensible Markup Language) is presented in this paper. The information publication for integrated E-Government system is realized based on web service and XSLT (Extensible Style sheet Language Transformations). The result shows that this solution of information publication has many advantages, such as easy to realize, and have greater value and application prospect of promotion.

articleTitle: Quality of the University Librarians
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: With the arrival of the era of information network, the demands for librarians have been raised to a new level. Librarians are required to possess not only such dominant qualities as good computer skills, proficiency in foreign language and basic professional ability, but also excellent recessive qualities.

articleTitle: An Electronic Seal Based on Wavelet Transform Solution
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: Based on the current e-government development, analysis and wavelet transform features of the electronic seal technology, a wavelet-based electronic seal solutions to improve the security of electronic data. Attack of the experiment, the security of the program can be drawn to meet actual needs.

articleTitle: Robust H8 Output Feedback Control for a Class of Networked Control Systems with Long Time-Delay
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: This paper studies the robust H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> output feedback control problem for a class of uncertain networked control systems (NCSs) with long time-delay. Firstly, the NCS model with a random long time-delay is transformed into a discrete-time system model with uncertain parameters. And then, a sufficient condition for the solvability of the robust H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> dynamic output feedback control problem is proved and presented by a proper Lyapunov function and linear matrix inequality. The systems under action of the given controller are robust and satisfy H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance. Finally, a numerical example is provided to demonstrate the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Forecast of Yangtze River Water Traffic Accidents Based on GM(1,1) Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: The gray prediction method (grey model) is a system containing uncertainty method for prediction. This article describes the typical gray prediction model GM (1,1), the Yangtze River water traffic accidents according to statistics using GM (1,1) model to predict the amount of water accidents, to verify the accuracy of forecasting methods, and to forecast future traffic volume.

articleTitle: Interactive 3D Visualization of Large CT Datasets
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we present an efficient, high-quality volume rendering algorithm using GPUs for rendering large CT datasets at interactive frame rates on standard PC hardware. We subdivide the volume dataset into uniform sized blocks and take advantage of combinations of early ray termination, empty-space skipping and visibility culling to accelerate the whole rendering process and render visible parts of volume data. We have implemented our volume rendering algorithm for a large volume data of 512×304×1878 dimensions (visible female), and achieved real-time performance (i.e., 3-4 frames per second) on a Pentium 4 2.4 GHz PC equipped with NVIDIA Geforce graphics card (512MB video memory). This method can be used as a 3D visualization tool of large CT datasets for doctors or radiologists.

articleTitle: Necessary Conditions of Convergence of Generalized Integral
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: This essay is intended to discuss the necessity of convergence of generalized integral and give several necessary conditions of convergence of generalized integral. In addition, for part of conclusion, examples will be given for the purpose of application.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Digital Educational Resources Sharing Platform Based on Semantic Web
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: Digital educational resources construction is enormous and growing at a staggering rate, the information lacks a uniform semantic description. So that users it difficult to find, organize, access and maintain the information required increasingly. we can realize optimal allocation of digital educational resources, balance the distribution of resources, narrow the resources gap between the rich and the poor, maximize the utilization rate of resources via the sharing platform of digital educational resources based on semantic Web, and which promote the discovery, exchange and sharing of the resource to meet the users'increasingly variegated requirements.

articleTitle: Study of Different Angle Inner Nozzle Flow Field Based on Suction-Type RC Bit
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the reverse circulation(RC) pumping performance and enhance the effect of RC, the suction-type RC bit on the basis of ejection theory was designed. And with theoretical calculations, computational fluid dynamics(CFD) and experiment, pressure field and velocity field produced by different angle inner nozzles were studied. It was discussed the feasibility of suction principle in enhancing RC effect, and at the same time it was provided a theoretical basis to optimize the design of RC bit. The results show that applying ejectors to improve RC performance is absolutely feasible. Also, the pressure field and velocity field produced by the suction-type RC bit, as the injection angle increases, the pumping capacity both intersection inner nozzle and spiral inner nozzle is decreased, and the spiral inner nozzle's changes rapidly.

articleTitle: Computer Control System Teaching Based on a Cooperatively Programmed Simulator
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: Computer Control Systems (CCS) course in Southwest University of China is introduced briefly. To solve teaching problems existed, a new Cooperatively Developing Teaching Method (CDTM) is presented. CDTM requires both teachers and students to work jointly. Each one is assigned with a different role and tasks. A teaching case using cooperatively programmed simulator is provided to evaluate the teaching effect. Actions include introducing fundamental knowledge, assigning tasks, drawing flowchart, programming, tuning PID parameters, discussing and evaluating. Most students participated in the case. This helps to promote their thinking and self-learning, foster their problem solving ability, improve their learning enthusiasm, and train their team consciousness. It is found that the teaching effect is enhanced.

articleTitle: The Parallel Waves Simulation Based on GPU
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: This paper bases on the observation and research results of oceanography, comes up with a method of ocean simulation that based on GPU. With the development of the hardware, specifically the high development of GPU and its high speed computing power make GPU a new research hotspot. The paper uses FFT algorithm to generate height map, makes use of GPU to improve realism of ocean, and OpenGL is used to draw light and color. By researching above algorithm and technology, we realize a wave simulation system. Experimental results show that this method achieves good results on realism and real-time effects.

articleTitle: The Study of Brand Image Design and Landscape Planning of Large Scale Events
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: The most stringent issue, which exhibition industry needs to confront with is lacking in integral design and spread of the brand image. Exhibitions merely act as a basic communication platform, and, most of time, it overall image are ignored by exhibiting companies' booth design and advertisements. Therefore, it is showing less competitiveness among cognate events. In this essay, in order to finding the unified brand image design's impact on enhancing visual effect and expanding brand culture, it will compare the brand image design and landscape planning of large scale events at home and abroad, and analyze from three ways, which are brand image design, landscape planning and dissemination of information.

articleTitle: Several 3D Graphic Ocean Waves Visual Simulation Based on Visual Basic and OpenGL
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: The ocean wave spectrum is used to simulate the wave. This research uses real sea spectrum to control the simulation process. First step is to make one two-dimensional picture into grids in which the height data can be imported through mathematical model. Simulating the sea level by means of the wave girds that consist of spatial point (x,y,z). To get the wave animation, it sets a time interval to change the wave frames which is made before in continually. At last utilize the Visual Basic and the free Open Graphics Library to make the visual simulation come true. Specifically, it observes when the wave number is below 10, the simulation effect begins to lose reality. While the wave number is over 30, the wave levels begin to shake. To get the best effect is when the number close to 24.

articleTitle: Tweets Reading Probability Analysis Based on Competing-Window Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: In microgblogs, a user usually follows or is followed by many other users. The content updating and reading is a complex process involving intensive interactions among publishers and readers. It also forms the basis of information diffusion in social networks. In the situation of massive followers, tweets reading would heavily depend on user behaviors and interactions. The tweets reading probability (TRP) would be a vital parameter measuring the effectiveness and influence of tweets. Our work proposed a fundamental model, namely competing-window, to simulate the process of multi-node interactions and analyzed TRP in social network. Based on Sina Microblog, we built a standard data set and run massive experiments on empirical data to extract user behavior patterns. By adopting simulating approaches, TRP in a none-preference social network was obtained. The results indicate that typical TRP is about 8% and different user behaviors affect TRP differently.

articleTitle: An Empirical Evaluation Study of Public Libraries Based on Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: Based on the theory of sustainable development, evaluation indexes system of public libraries has been established. Principal component analysis was applied in the empirical study of public libraries in Chongqing in recent years. Three principal components have been chosen, and the comprehensive evaluation model was established. It is concluded that the development level of public libraries in Chongqing has been increasing, and it proved that principal component analysis is a feasible and effective method in the evaluation research of public libraries. This work provides theory support for the evaluation study of public libraries.

articleTitle: The Application Research on Repository Management of University Digital Assets
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: With the popularity of computer and network, "Digital Campus" project is become the current development trend of the universities. As more and more research and educational material is born digital, institutions and universities are increasingly realizing the need for a stable place in which such digital assets may be stored and accessed long-term. It is the challenge of the university digital assets management. In this paper we propose to combine digital assets management with institutional repository. To collect, organize, store, manage a series of digital research output, and it can be an excellent platform for future research and development.

articleTitle: Surgery Prediction and Simulation Based on Correction of Orbital Hypertelorism
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: Simulation and three-dimensional visualization of object motion is a prerequisite for any surgical planning system. Orbital hypertelorism is a disease, which is most commonly associated with craniofacial malformations. We have developed a surgical planning system for planning and evaluation of orbital hypertelorism surgery. In our system CT-based virtual surface models fitted by oriented bounding boxes (OBB) are manipulated. Three-dimensional motion as well as a correction surgery can be simulated. Both are controlled by collision detection. The computer-based interactive surgery simulation systems (CISSS) presented here can take virtual surgical operation and forecast facial features after the correction of orbital hypertelorism, our surgical planning time is shorter than the current methods.

articleTitle: Application Research of Transaction Properties in Migrating Workflow
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: This article introduced the concept of migrating workflow and transaction, described the most critical atomicity and conformance requirements in the transaction properties, proposed the concept of transactional workflow and the four properties that need to meet, finally, analyzed the features of migrating workflow and the unique requirements of the transaction properties, and gave the transaction implementation model of migrating workflow.

articleTitle: A Tentative Study on Financial Software and Intelligent Financial System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: This paper first puts forward the definition of Financial Intelligence and clarifies the connotation of Intelligent Financial Software, followed by the analysis of the design goal and overall framework of the Intelligent Financial System. In this way, it offers certain theoretical reference for the development of Financial Software in the intelligent aspect.

articleTitle: Entanglement of Graph Qutrit States
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: The number of inequivalent classes of up to 8-qutrit graph states is 1002, with 239 decomposable graphs and 763 indecomposable graphs. Apparently, the former can be decomposed to several indecomposable parts. For qubit graph states, the upper and lower bounds of entanglement have been given. If the two bounds don't coincide, the entanglement can be calculated by iterative method. For qutrit graph states, their lower bounds can be found through the local complementation operations. But its hard to find the upper bound because the qutrit graph states have 2 basis states which are GHZ state and W state. Fortunately, the iterative method can also be used here. In this paper, we calculated the entanglement of all the 1002 graph states. Through researching the results, we found the similar feature with graph qubit states that the decimal part of entanglement is stable.

articleTitle: Research on Campus Network IPV6 Transition Technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces the development status IPV6, and then made a complete campus network ipv6 solution. including the campus boundaries to connect other ipv6 network technology, tunneling inside the campus network, and DNS adjustments. in practice, confirmed the Feasibility.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of Clementine-Based Data Mining Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a case of application of data mining of intentional house purchase factors. The data were collected from the Wuhan Real Estate Bureau by questionnaire. With a focus on data mining process, we analyze the data mining model and its application based on Clementine package.

articleTitle: The Design of NPKI System Based LDAP
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: This paper propounds a NPKI model based LDAP directory service, the system combines the LDAP directory service and NPKI organically. In the case of the number of the certificate large increase, the system use LDAP directory to store a variety of certificates and certificate revocation list, achieve a distributed directory service through the division and recommendations of directory information, improve the reliability of the directory service greatly, simplify the management of directory service system and directory user, and solve the problem of load balancing.

articleTitle: Analysis of Informatization Construction in Coal Enterprise Based on SaaS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: Software as a Service (abbreviated as SaaS) is a new informationization model that promoted for SMEs. This paper analyzes the basic characteristics and application areas of SaaS at first. Generally speaking, the departments and branches of coal enterprises are located in various places, and its business is also more similar to the other. So authors propose to develop information system based on the SaaS model for coal enterprises, and give the steps to implement. This program can solve many problems in the informationization of coal enterprises, such as uneven development, huge investment and low rate of growth and so on, and improve coal enterprises informationization developed in depth.

articleTitle: Security Analysis and Improvement of Dual Signature in Electronic Payment System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: The article studies the process that the double signature in electronic payment system process cannot resist replay attack and gives an improved scheme, and then analyzes the security of the scheme. It is proved to be able to resist the replay Attack after the analysis of the scheme.

articleTitle: Things with the Privacy Protection Technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: Things are information technology development to a certain stage of the product, the concepts of things also entered the people's attention. Things are all the articles and other sensing devices through radio frequency identification information connected to the Internet, intelligent identification and management, is the second computer, Internet and mobile communication network again after the wave of the information industry. This paper analyzes the face of things several security issues, and proposed security mechanisms related things.

articleTitle: A Data Translation Service in Semantic Grid Environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: Semantic grid, the cross field of semantic web and grid computing, has received significant attention recently. Our workgroup develops a resource management semantic grid - RM-Grid to enhance information process accuracy and efficiency in semantic heterogeneity environment. This paper describes the architecture of RM-grid, mainly introduces the data translation service of RM-Grid. It puts forward an ontology based common semantic model and an XML based data model, presents the data translation algorithm between different data sources and an adapter framework for accessing distributed heterogeneous resources as well.

articleTitle: An Application of Image Information Measure in Edge Detection
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: The information measure is the important parameter reflecting edge characteristic of image. Three basic features of edge point have been represented using information measure technology to distill edge information. This paper has proposed a computing method of information measure and a basic method of distilling edge information using image information measure with nearby area consistency measure as an example The experiment shows that information measure technology characterizes the basic features of edge point sufficiently when distill edge information, and this method has a good ability of resisting voice.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Fuzzy Mutative Scale Chaos Optimization Algorithm and Application
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: Based on the fuzzy mathematics and chaos optimization theory, this paper proposes an algorithm of the Multi-objective Fuzzy Mutative Scale Chaos Optimization Algorithm (MFMSCOA) to solve various types of Multi-objective Optimization Problems (MOP). The multi-objectives optimization problems will ex-press the fuzzy optimization problems by delimiting membership degree functions of objective functions in a fuzzy way. Then, according to the Maximum and minimum rule of the fuzzy set theory, one can transfer a multi-objective optimization problem into a single objective nonlinear programming problem by applying the idea of fuzzy asymmetric method and the biggest satisfaction principle in fuzzy set theory. Lastly, the most sat-is factory solution will be obtained by the application of MFMSCOA. Theoretical analyze and Simulation results show that the proposed MFMSCOA is feasible and effective. It will provide a novel way to solve the multi-objective optimization problems.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Basic Education Information Management System Base on SSH
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the special characteristics of basic education information management system, this paper proposes the simple solution based on the architectures of Struts, Spring and Hibernate (referred to as SSH) of J2EE and its specific implementation process. Furthermore, it is proved by the practical application that it can not only greatly reduce system developing time, but also get a good robustness, maintainability, scalability and flexibility.

articleTitle: Key Technology Research on the Reproduction of Flight Level Path in Approach and Landing Phase
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: The reproduction of flight path during the aircraft approach and landing phase is an important part of flight unsafe incidents investigation. This article gives a method of extracting and processing flight parameter aiming at the problem that flight record data has a poor integrality, high rate of change and is hard to generated by flight path directly in that phase. In this article the airport environment which around aircraft in the landing phase is modeled, the flight path is reproduced by latitude and longitude and flight performance data, the flight path is calibrated in two ways, which one using a specific location point and other using the average latitude and longitude position point. The flight path which calibrated in the approach and landing phase which meets the needs of the project is obtained.

articleTitle: Concept-Lattice-Based Text Filtering System Design and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: The study of traditional text filtering with keywords retrieval ignores the semantic relations between keywords, and it results in the bottleneck of the further development of text filtering. To solve this problem, three steps are adopted. Firstly, concept lattice theory should be introduced into traditional text filtering, the formal context is employed to organize filtering text and domain feature words, and then the concept lattice is created. Secondly, the structure of concept lattice and the relevancy of Object-Properties are used to convert the match between text and user information demands into the match between concept lattice nodes and the user's information demands, and then the text filtering is achieved. Lastly, the semantic relations between concepts are measured, and the domain ontology is used to calculate the similarity between domain feature words and user interest feature words, and then the accuracy of text filtering is improved. In order to achieve this goal, a concept-lattice-based text filtering model (CL-TFM) is proposed, the algorithm of related concept lattice progressive construction and the computing method of domain ontology based conceptual similarity are constructed, and a novel text filtering system named as CL-TFS (Concept Lattice based Text Filtering System) is designed and implemented. The related experimental results show that the recall and precision rates of the text filtering system of CL-TFS has obvious advantages superior to the ones of keyword-based text filtering system.

articleTitle: Ransform Based on Singular Value Solution for Electronic Seal
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: According to the current e-government development, analysis of the characteristics of digital watermarking technology, a digital watermarking-based solutions for electronic seals to increase the security of electronic data.

articleTitle: Understanding and Application of Gauss Theorem in Electrostatic Field
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: Correct understanding and mastering electrostatic field of Gauss theorem is the key part of learning electromagnetism, the field strength E in Gaussian theorem is the total field strength excited by all charges in the space on the closed surface, E=Ein+Eout. The sum of E refers to the algebra sum of charges in the closed surface, When charge distribution has certain symmetry(Spherical symmetry, axial symmetry, plane symmetry), we can use Gauss theorem to calculate the distribution of the electric field.

articleTitle: Implementation Functions of WebGIS Based on Bitmap
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: As a kind of GIS technology based on B/S pattern, Web GIS has been widely applied. However, in certain specific circumstances, such as lack of digital vector maps, or the precision of digital map can not meet the request, the function of GIS can not be achieved. Since the acquisition of bitmap is relatively easy, this paper put forward a new method with JavaApplet technology to deal with bitmap instead of using the professional map engine software to achieve the function of WebGIS, and explored a new and effective solution for the special applications of WebGIS.

articleTitle: The Evaluation of the Self-Propelled Artilley Battle Power Based on Component Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the objectiveness of the evaluation of the self-propelled artilley battle power, the principal component analysis method translate multivariate variable to less and independent variable, what include original and mostly information and reduce artificial influence. Based based on Principal Component Analysis method in this text, author evaluate war power of six kinds of self-propelled artilley, at last give sequencing.

articleTitle: Direct Decomposition about Direct Sum Decomposition of Space
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: Space direct sum decomposition of the algebra plays an important role, This article will explore it from several aspects as follow. The approach to space direct sum decomposition, The application of dimension formulas in space direct sum decomposition, The utilization of linear hull (generated subspace) in space direct sum decomposition, Using the linear transformation of digitalization on finite-dimensional vector space to decoupage V into the direct sum of characteristic subspaces.

articleTitle: A Survey on Classified Document Protection Means
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: Means for classified documents protection have been developing from simple and traditional ways like identity authentication, file encryption, host supervisory and operation audit to integrated and new style ways, like transparent encryption, intranet integrated supervisory, documents concentrated management and virtual security control. This paper introduces the principles and technologies taken by those means, analyses their abilities and disadvantages, and discusses the development trend of this area.

articleTitle: Research on Multivariate Grain Information Service Platform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: A framework of digital grain information service platform which integrate kinds of functions of grain circulation, collection of storage and processing information, real-time monitoring and traceability of the quality of grain, early-warning the quantity of grain supply, grain information publication, etc, has been designed, on the basis of analyzing the current situation of grain information and multi-elements of grain information services. Taking the platform as infrastructure of grain information can contribute to reduce cost of grain circulation, stabilize grain production and ensure grain security.

articleTitle: Processing Query in P2P XML Data Sources
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: P2P technology provides new views for data integration purposes. In P2P systems, there is no global knowledge, neither a global schema nor information of data distribution or indices. An important issue in the context of schema-based P2P systems is efficient query processing. Because of the lack of global knowledge, query planning is much more difficult than in centralized systems. In this paper, we assume XML as the native data model for all peers, and address the problem of distributed query processing in the P2P XML data sources. We discuss strategies of query decomposition and routing based on different kinds of routing indexes. In our work, FLWR queries of XML data are translated into algebraic expressions, and are executed by relying on data-integration-like techniques. To speed up query execution and to decrease peer and super peer workload, we exploits mechanisms for replicating peer content, and for caching query plans and query results.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Test Strategy for WebGame
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: WebGame is a very popular browser-based online game, and user can easily enjoy it using any computer that connected to the Internet. In WebGame development, many games are not well tested for various reasons. As a result, the user experience and the playability of the game are poor, and ultimately the game was abandoned. Based on the analysis of the general Web application testing technology, we analyzed the characteristics of WebGame testing, and give some test strategies for WebGame.

articleTitle: 3D Volume Clipping Based on Distance Field
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a 3D volume clipping method based on volume distance field, which is suitable for texture-based volume rendering and exploit per-fragment operation on the graphics hardware to implement clipping. High frame rates are achieved and therefore interactive explorations and clippings of volume data are supported.

articleTitle: The Comparative Study on Software Industry Service System of Cross Strait
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Intelligence Science and Information Engineering
abstract: This paper inspected the related theories of the software industry service system firstly, according to the components of the software industry service structure to compare the various methods on the aspects of service system and service methods etc. of cross strait, then advances some opinions and puts forward some suggestions to improve and perfect the software industry services in Haixi area.
